I inspected CartmanFatass/My-paper-code at the exact origin-reachable commit 2b8f1ae0ea8c514bd333c45fe11275a2fabfbb81, not a newer revision. The direction file preserves a narrow historical result rather than broadening it; the B1 result records IID_RAW_plus=true, IID_TIMING_plus=false, and eligible_exposure_link_composite_gate=false. B2 deliberately held the exponential exposure map fixed in both arms and stated that even a positive rate-flexibility result could not identify that link; its final result instead marked ABSORB_TO_GLOBAL_RATE=true, RETAIN_RATE_FLEX=false, and material_positive_gate=false. The corresponding source defines eligible exposure from physical boundary clocks and realizes the map as u=−expm1(−λe); I use that only as provenance, not as authority over the newly frozen seven-tick host. No B3 scientific object, policy, coordinate, threshold, or derived result entered this analysis.

Disposition: non-divisibility does not rescue the exponential link. It does create a real service-side difference, but the optimized exponential family pays enough additional renewal cost that its direct return is lower than the optimized common-rate family.

Boundary and phase ambiguity

Under the frozen ordering, there is no unresolved phase choice:

each cycle starts immediately after renewal;

the next opportunity is exactly Δ ticks later;

service for the interval is accrued before its ending action;

the renewal affects only the following interval.

Any implementation in which the boundary-at-eight renewal retroactively services tick eight would be implementing a different host. That mistake would replace the correct 7−3q service expectation in the four-tick stratum with an eight-tick-style shortcut.

9. Does an executable observation remain scientifically necessary?

No result-bearing executable observation can change the branch while the mathematical host remains frozen. There is no sampling uncertainty, optimization uncertainty, learned state, or unenumerated base parameter. Exact renewal-reward algebra plus the complete 17-point enumeration determines the answer.

A minimal executable conformance witness could still test whether an implementation represents the intended host:

Δ=4,K=2⟹(length,service,cost,J)=(8,7,2,5/8).

An exhaustive program should then reproduce the four optimizer rows in the table. A disagreement would diagnose an ordering, weighting, arithmetic, or implementation error; it would not constitute contrary evidence about this frozen mathematical object.

10. Narrowest defensible claim

On the single deterministic seven-tick-service, spacings-{1,4}, cost-two, equal-physical-time-weighted, sixteenths-grid, state-blind memoryless renewal host, linking boundary probabilities through a common executed physical rate materially improves direct return over sharing one raw boundary probability and comes within 5/2048 of the unrestricted per-stratum memoryless grid optimum. Exact exponential survival linking does not provide distinct direct-return value over common rate: it produces more service but incurs still more renewal cost and trails common rate by 9,753,755/536,870,912.

The strongest supporting evidence is common rate’s proximity to the unrestricted memoryless optimum and its material advantage over raw. The strongest counterpressure is that exponential obtains higher service, showing that non-divisibility does change policy behavior. The decisive contradiction to exponential specificity is that this service gain is smaller than its extra charge.

The principal unresolved alternative is not another one-parameter link inside this cell. It is age dependence: the age-conditioned ceiling is approximately 0.66964, far above every state-blind memoryless family. Shared dependencies remain the deterministic lifetime, periodic boundaries, fixed cost two, equal physical-time weights, post-interval action ordering, and finite base grid.

The smallest genuinely new link discriminator is a prospectively selected held-out third spacing: optimize each one-parameter family only on the present Δ={1,4} strata, then evaluate the implied transformed probability on the third spacing without retuning. Freeze that spacing, its physical-time weight, and its margin before evaluation, and retain unrestricted-q, KEEP, and charge-matched-shell references. That would test an out-of-sample functional prediction of the link rather than repeatedly asking which one-dimensional curve happens to lie closer to a two-coordinate optimum. Even a positive result there would remain a link-transfer result, not evidence for a literal hazard, learned ONLGR value, lease or rebinding causality, arbitrary periods, variable populations, UAV transfer, safety, or PPO superiority.
